t: You're on Greek Street in Soho, which runs south from Soho Square down to Shaftesbury Avenue. It's famous for its restaurants and its cosmopolitan feel. Two people connect to the street. Richard D'Oyly Carte, the English theatre manager and producer, was born here in 1844. And Ann Elliot, a courtesan and actress who appeared in comedies in London and Dublin, died here in 1769, aged only twenty-six. Her admirers included an Earl of Bristol and Prince Henry, Duke of Cumberland.
